messages:
mira: Quick sync — prospect requests POC: streaming SDK -> function-calls for enrichment -> newline-delimited JSON to their on-prem parser. They require customer-managed KMS/HSM + SOC2 excerpts before pilot. Any blockers?

alex: From infra side: streaming + function_calls is supported. Their reverse proxy strips Authorization unless we do mTLS or use ephemeral signed URLs.

judy: Cost note: if they expect ~15 qps with ~600 tokens out, recommend reserved capacity. I can model on-demand vs 6mo/12mo reserved.

prashant: For strict JSON lines use structured-output binding + runtime schema enforcement. Prompt suffix: "Return exactly one JSON object per line with keys id,verdict,score,meta. No extra text."

sec-bot: SOC2 Type II available. KMS: customer-managed keys supported via KMIP/AWS/Azure for Private; HSM attestation depends on vendor. Compliance bundle ticket INC-1723 created, ETA 48h.
